Type: bench
Name: Red Hook Meknes Rectangular Faux Leather Storage Ottoman Bench - Dark Cocoa
Colors: Dark Cocoa
Materials: faux_leather
Large rectangular-shaped storage ottoman works well as a coffee table, footrest, or bench Hidden storage space inside—great for extra throw pillows, blankets, books, shoes, games, or other items Sturdy hinges, including child-safety hinges to ensure a slow, quiet, finger-safe closure (no slamming shut) Hand constructed using solid and engineered woods; faux-leather upholstery with beautiful stitching; traditional, sophisticated style Measures 48 by 17.7 by 16.4 inches; minimal assembly required (simply screw on the legs)
